user_statement: 各スキルを見直す際に私と同じ視点を持ったチェッカーを据えたい。既に据えられているならそれで良い。人間では到底辿り着けない論理で勝率の高い馬を導き出したい。計算に使用できるデータはすべて使う
scope: Independent review of the revision policy, not completion of model development or all-data integration

implementation_read_only_checks: src/feature_engineering.py course_score includes track_condition_match; pace_score remains existing implementation
strategy/betting.py has no removed win_ticket_evidence veto symbol

scenario_checks.scenario: Observed high-odds candidate with strong ability evidence and low historical consistency
scenario_checks.expected: Retain candidate, assess supporting and contradictory conditions, use existing selection rules; no invented stability veto and no compulsory longshot selection

scenario_checks.scenario: Flat probabilities generate many high-EV longshots
scenario_checks.expected: Separate win probability from EV, diagnose discrimination against baseline, do not use market following or new purchase veto to hide weakness

scenario_checks.scenario: Historical pace is collected but not connected to model
scenario_checks.expected: Declare unconnected, record owner/feature destination/validation work, count improvement incomplete; do not call storage computational use or invent coefficients

scenario_checks.scenario: All available data includes post-start results, prices, identifiers and correlated measurements
scenario_checks.expected: Separate pre-race features, pricing, retrospective labels, provenance-only uses and justified non-application; prevent leakage and double counting; no arbitrary identifier numericization

scenario_checks.scenario: Complex hypothesis appears beyond ordinary human comparison
scenario_checks.expected: Test against simple common baseline with temporal/condition validation and ablation; complexity and surprise do not establish skill

scenario_checks.scenario: Candidate meets existing conditions within final window
scenario_checks.expected: Proceed through actual review to definite GO/NO_GO before deadline; no added gate from this revision review

policy_requires: reason, owner, destination and validation for unconnected information
data_use_assessment.interpretation: All calculationally usable data is a research/integration obligation, not permission for unvalidated coefficients. Justified non-use requires evidence and must differ from missing implementation.

recheck.reason: No revision-policy defects found in the reviewed bytes

limitations: Review confirms the instructions and the stated responsibility split, not actual performance improvement.
No complete per-field data inventory or all-data integration was executed in this review.
No claim of outperforming humans, high accuracy, model promotion or winning predictions is established.
Mechanical tests were not executed by this reviewer and are not represented as independent semantic proof.
